messages:
jonah (sales): Acme POC blocked. Ingest job fails when using function calls + json_mode; parser errors out due to extra human-friendly suffix. Trial ends Tue.
acme-ops (customer): repro paste: 
```{\"batch\": [{\"id\": \"42\", \"ok\": true}]}
Note: last record had a warning about input quality.```
kevin (solutions): can you share request id & whether you're streaming? also SDK version.
acme-ops (customer): req=ac_991, sdk=1.4, stream=true. Our logs show a couple 429s around the same time:
```
2024-09-10T14:05:12Z WARN req ac_991 429 TooManyRequests qps=37 limit=35
2024-09-10T14:05:13Z INFO partial ac_991 "{\"batch\": [...] } Some human note"
```
mina (eng-runtime): Streaming + json_mode + token-limit/rate-limit often causes a trailing sentence. Short fixes: 1) set header `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` 2) route option `truncate_suffix=true` 3) bump token ceiling so model doesn't tack on explanation.
rate-bot: Alert: org acme qps spike at 2024-09-10T14:05:12Z (37)
kevin (solutions): parallel path: offer a short-term QPS bump for the POC window or suggest Dedicated eval. I'll loop in sales-ops for pricing.
harper (security): Acme requires retention 365d and encrypted-at-rest logs. If we enable Dedicated burst, confirm we can redact request bodies.
mina (eng-runtime): Dedicated can be configured with body redaction and custom retention in contract; hosted default is 30d. For immediate runtime mitigation we can enable `atomic_response=true` for their route (buffer & validate before sending) which avoids exposing partial/trailing text.
acak (customer): applied strict + truncate_suffix locally: success rate improved to ~97%, still seeing ~3% truncated when 429s happen. Sending new id ac_992.
kevin (solutions): please send ac_992 logs. We'll prepare a runbook: required headers, a client retry snippet for parse failures (one immediate retry if status==200), and pricing options for a 2-week QPS uplift vs Dedicated trial.
jonah (sales): thanks — I'll get legal and sales-ops in the loop for retention and short-term pricing. Acme, please keep samples coming. :thumbsup:
